nodes.title: EdgeConv pseudo-head specialization
nodes.evidence: Strong internal pseudo-head groups: L1:ch16:32, L2:ch224:256, L0:ch40:48, L1:ch112:128, L0:ch24:32.
nodes.risk: Equal channel slicing may hide or split real functional groups.
nodes.next_test: Add activation-cluster pseudo-heads and random channel-group controls.

nodes.title: Leading-particle core hypothesis
nodes.evidence: top_pt ablation acc=0.4488 vs random=0.7250; gap=0.2762.
nodes.risk: top_pt and top_energy highly overlap; need top-k sweep.
nodes.next_test: Run k sweep k=1,2,4,8,16 and per-class particle ablation.

nodes.title: EdgeConv learned-neighborhood separator
nodes.evidence: Best EdgeConv pseudo-head 1:ch16:32 drops acc 0.7574->0.4934; full EdgeConv layers also previously dropped accuracy near random.
nodes.risk: Channel-head groups are fixed slices, not learned clusters yet.
nodes.next_test: Cluster EdgeConv activations and patch learned clusters; run heldout stability.

nodes.title: Explicit feature-channel class codes
nodes.evidence: label_H4q->part_pt_log, label_Hbb->part_logerel, label_Hcc->part_logerel, label_Hgg->part_deta, label_Hqql->part_pt_log, label_QCD->part_deta, label_Tbl->part_deta, label_Tbqq->part_deltaR
nodes.risk: Zeroing feature channels may be out-of-distribution.
nodes.next_test: Permutation/noise controls and class contrast reports.

nodes.title: Known-observable alignment
nodes.evidence: Tbqq-vs-Tbl: route ΔR gap L1=0.0539, sdmass gap=54.6329, nparticles gap=22.1602.
nodes.risk: May be explained by known mass/multiplicity only.
nodes.next_test: Residual analysis after controlling for sdmass/nparticles/tau variables.

nodes.title: Wqq compact route vs Tbqq wide route
nodes.evidence: Mean neighbor ΔR gap Tbqq-Wqq ≈ 0.1242 across route layers.
nodes.risk: Route stats are descriptive; may be explained by mass/multiplicity.
nodes.next_test: Causal route-group patch: compact vs wide edges; regress against jet mass and nparticles.

nodes.title: Error-route hypothesis
nodes.evidence: Not tested yet: wrong predictions may share route/feature pattern with predicted class.
nodes.next_test: Build error atlas true->pred pairs with route stats and signed competing logits.

nodes.title: Transformer attention route hypothesis
nodes.evidence: ParT attention cannot be claimed until ParT accuracy is fixed.
nodes.risk: Current ParT checkpoint invocation is invalid for claims.
nodes.next_test: Find/train valid ParT checkpoint, then extract attention heads / pair bias.
